description: Dhawunirodha iyo yakakurudzirwa modhi kuti utange kutaura, kana kutarisa Hub kune imwe.
checkEngineGpuUnused: {{backend}} ndeye CPU-inovaka chete, saka {{gpus}} inogara isina chayakaita. Sarudza GPU backend muZvirongwa kuti uishandise.
checkEngineVendorMismatch: {{backend}} inoda {{vendor}} GPU, asi Novera yawanikwa {{gpus}}. Novera ichamhanya pana CPU.
checkEngineRuntimeUnreachable: {{backend}} haikwanise kusvika GPU yako, saka Novera ichamhanya pana CPU. Izvi zvinowanzoreva kuti GPU mutyairi kana kuti nguva yekumhanya inoda kuvandudzwa.
checkEngineMissingLibrary: {{backend}} haikwanisi kutanga nekuti raibhurari inodiwa haipo ({{libraries}}), saka Novera ichashanda pana CPU.
checkEngineProbeFailed: Haikwanisi kusimbisa kuti injini inogona kushandisa yako GPU
checkEngineUnavailable: Iyi injini yekuvaka haigone kutaura GPU mamiriro
checkSearchNoVector: Iyo yekumisikidza modhi haina mhedzisiro, saka faira yekutsvaga haisati yashanda
checkSearchInvalidVector: Iyo yekumisikidza modhi yakadzosa mhedzisiro, saka kutsvaga kwefaira hakuna kudzoka
checkSearchUnavailable: Ichi chivakwa cheinjini hachigone kuratidza iyo yekumisikidza modhi
welcomeTitle: Novera inoda kuseta pane yako system
welcomeBody: Izvi zvinotora maminetsi mashoma: Novera inodhawunirodha injini yekufungidzira uye modhi diki yekutsvaga faira. Unogona kuramba uchishandisa komputa yako painenge ichimhanya.
dsparkDescription: Dhaunirodha DSpark Q8_0 mumwe wake ({{size}})) yeLFM2.5-2.6B. Inogona kukurumidzira kugadzira, asi inoshandisa imwe RAM kana VRAM, ichisiya ndangariro shoma yezvirikuitika. Zviedze pahardware yako; gadzirisa kureba kwechirevo kana kudzima decoding yekufungidzira mumaseting emuenzaniso.
